title: Above-average salaries
description: Return the name and salary of employees who earn more than the average salary of all employees.
expected_query: SELECT name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees);

title: Pricey products
description: Return the name and price of products that cost more than the average product price.
expected_query: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products);

title: Customers without orders
description: Return the names of customers who have never placed an order.
expected_query: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders);

title: Best paid in each department
description: Return the name, department_id and salary of the highest-paid employee in each department.
expected_query: SELECT name, department_id, salary FROM employees e WHERE salary = (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM employees WHERE department_id = e.department_id);
